tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Netgear GS724TP 24-Port ProSafe Gigabit PoE Managed Switch with 2 SFP Ports


The Netgear GS724TP 24-Port ProSafe Gigabit PoE Managed Switch is a reliable, business-class networking solution designed for small to medium enterprises, offices, schools, and surveillance systems. With 24 Gigabit PoE ports and 2 dedicated SFP uplink ports, this switch delivers high performance, flexible management, and efficient power distribution for modern network environments.


Key Features


  • 24 × Gigabit Ethernet PoE Ports
    Supports IEEE 802.3af PoE, allowing you to power IP cameras, VoIP phones, and wireless access points directly through the network cable.

  • 2 × Gigabit SFP Uplink Ports
    Provides high-speed fiber connectivity for long-distance uplinks and backbone connections.

  • Smart Managed Switch
    Advanced Layer 2 management features including VLAN, QoS, IGMP Snooping, Link Aggregation, and port monitoring for better traffic control and security.

  • High PoE Power Budget
    Ideal for powering multiple PoE devices without requiring additional power adapters.

  • Reliable Gigabit Performance
    Ensures fast data transfer, low latency, and stable network operation for business applications.

  • Rack-Mountable Metal Design
    Durable, professional-grade build suitable for server racks or network cabinets.
